title: Total student loan debt outstanding
cap: Student loan balances on consumer credit reports, second quarter of each year, in billions of current dollars (Federal Reserve Bank of New York Household Debt and Credit Report). 2013 from the NY Fed's 2013 Q2 presentation; 2016, 2019 and 2022 from the Q2 releases of those years (rounded to $10bn as published); 2026 from the Q2 2026 report; 2025 derived as the 2026 balance less the reported $13bn year-on-year increase.
